_meta.units: ns, ohm, pF, nH, V, mm unless a key says otherwise
_meta.corners: min / typ / max are datasheet columns. Keys ending in _est, and every value in a block marked "est": true, are engineering estimates (no datasheet value).
_meta.copied_from: Gather phase of the 2026-10-31 J12 study (devices.json, delay.json); every datasheet value was checked again against the datasheet text.

datasheets.UCC27524A: TI SLUSBP4C (revised June 2024), D-package rows (same values as the SLUSFA9 DSD rows: the older die)

gpio.model: Pad current I = Isat * tanh(Vdrop / (Rs * Isat)), switched by an internal 0-1 ramp k(t). Pull-up and pull-down sides are separate.
gpio.drive_src: Rs: slope of the typical V-I curves, RP2350 datasheet 14.9.4.1 Figure 154 (typical part, 25 C). Isat (current above the plotted range): est.
gpio.strength_note: Scale multiplies Isat and divides Rs. est (the datasheet says other parts lie between the typical curve and the limit).

floor.src: RP2350 Table 1683: VOH min 2.62 V, VOL max 0.5 V at the set drive current, IOVDD 3.3 V. The runner solves the scale that puts the pad exactly on these limits.

gpio.ramp_note: Internal pre-driver ramp, 0-100 %. The datasheet gives no rise/fall time for SLEWFAST = 0 or 1. est

reset_default.src: RP2350 PADS_BANK0 GPIOx reset values (DRIVE = 4 mA, SLEWFAST = 0); src/ never changes them

gpio.abs_max_src: RP2350 datasheet 14.9.1 Table 1680: VPIN max IOVDD + 0.5 V

pad.esd_diodes: to IOVDD and GND, IS 1e-14 A, N 1.2, RS 5 ohm

pico_path.note: RP2350 pad to Pico 2 W castellated pin (trace 10-25 mm, not published), male pin and J14/J15 socket contact (5-10 nH, 0.5-1.5 pF). Same values for GP11, GP12, GP13 and GP14.

SN74LVC1G04.vsw_src: VIL max 0.35 x VCC and VIH min 0.65 x VCC (SCES214AF Table 5.3); typ 0.9 V = VCC/2 est. The real threshold lies in this band.
SN74LVC1G04.tpd_src: SCES214AF Table 5.7, VCC 1.8 V +/- 0.15 V, CL 30 pF, RL 1 k (min/max). No typ is given: 4.1 ns est (from SN74LVC04A).
SN74LVC1G04.rout_src: max derived from VOH 1.2 V / VOL 0.45 V at 4 mA, VCC 1.65 V (SCES214AF Table 5.5); min/typ est

SN74LVC04A.vsw_src: VIL max / VIH min 0.35 / 0.65 x VCC (SCAS281T Table 6.3); typ est
SN74LVC04A.rout_src: max derived from VOH 1.2 V / VOL 0.45 V at 4 mA, -40..85 C (SCAS281T Table 6.7); min/typ est

SN74AHCT1G08.vsw_src: VIL max 0.8 V, VIH min 2.0 V (SCLS315S Table 5.3); typ 1.4 V est
SN74AHCT1G08.tpd_src: SCLS315S Table 5.6, VCC 5 V +/- 0.5 V, CL 15 pF, -40..85 C
SN74AHCT1G08.rout_src: max derived from VOH 3.8 V at 8 mA, VCC 4.5 V, -40..125 C (SCLS315S Table 5.5); min/typ est

UCC27524_new.label: UCC27524DR, new die (fitted part, SLUSFA9 D row)
UCC27524_new.td_min_note: SLUSFA9 gives no min for D/DGN; 6 ns is the older-die min (est lower bound)
UCC27524_new.roh_min_note: No min specified; Hardware.md amplitude budget uses 0 ohm
UCC27524_new.rol_min_note: No min specified; 0.15 ohm from the older-die row (est)
UCC27524_new.src: SLUSFA9 6.5 (VINx_H, VINx_L, ROH, ROL, D/DGN) and 6.6 (tD1x, tD2x: VINx_H crossing to 10 % output rise, VINx_L crossing to 90 % output fall, CLOAD 1.8 nF)

UCC27524_legacy.label: UCC27524 older die / UCC27524ADR (SLUSBP4C D rows)
UCC27524_legacy.src: SLUSBP4C 5.5/5.6 D-package rows = SLUSFA9 6.5/6.6 DSD rows. The JLC listing for C465729 quotes these values, so a reel can hold this die.

2EDN7524F.label: Infineon 2EDN7524F (same pinout, footprint swap only)
2EDN7524F.src: Rev. 2.7 Table 12 (VINH, VINL), Table 13 (RONSRC, RONSNK at 50 mA), Table 14 (tPDlh, tPDhl, CLOAD 1.8 nF, VDD 12 V)

UCC27517A.label: TI UCC27517A (SOT-23-5, new footprint, no enable pin)
UCC27517A.src: SLUSBQ0C 8.5 (VIN_H typ 2.2 / max 2.4 V, VIN_L min 1.0 V, hysteresis 1.0 V; ROH 5.0 / 7.5, ROL 0.5 / 1.0 at VDD 12 V) and 8.6 (tD1 4 / 13 / 23 ns, VDD 12 V, 1.8 nF). VIN_H min, VIN_L typ/max, ROH min and ROL min: est.

_common.note: Input capacitance is not specified (SLUSFA9 7.3.2: 'very low'). The output is an internal ramp behind ROH (rise) or ROL (fall). For the delay calibration into the 1.8 nF test load the rising edge uses ROH || r_boost (SLUSFA9 7.3.4: an NMOS of about 1.04 ohm also pulls up during the edge). The ramp time is an estimate; edge rate into 1.8 nF is not matched (peak-current limit not modelled).

output_corners._note: Same corners as Hardware.md 'Amplitude budget' and 'Output mode'. Timing corner min uses 'high', typ 'typ', max 'low'.

r2512.note: ESL 1-2 nH and Cp 0.05-0.15 pF est; pad C: parallel plate over In1 (1.40 x 3.35 mm, 0.2104 mm, er 4.5)

bnc.note: KH-BNC50-3511: 50 ohm (JLC listing); internal length 15-25 mm and launch C 0.5-1 pF est

coax.note: RG-58, velocity factor 0.66 (generic); loss ignored for <= 3 m (est 0.15 dB/m at 100 MHz)

loads.camera_note: IDS 1.8 V trigger input; IDS publishes no capacitance or thresholds. Ribbon cable not modelled.

firmware_duty.src: src/pulse_timing.h: 2 x MARKERWIDTH <= 1/FREQ (marker, J10 on 2-3); with COMBINE 1 and J10 on 1-2, DELAY >= WIDTH + 1 cycle and DELAY <= 1/FREQ - 2 x WIDTH give 2 x WIDTH < 2/3 x 1/FREQ (Hardware.md 'Board output rating')

option_d.gpio: GP14 (Pico pin 19, pad J14.19, unconnected today)
option_d.note: Estimated 90 mm route J14.19 -> U19.2 with one via (70-100 mm est). U19.2 is cut from PWM_TRIG_TAP.
